name: Canton Royale
why_it_matters: The all-day multi-cuisine room at Hotel Surya Kaiser Palace — al fresco wing under mango trees, pan-Asian and Mediterranean alongside North Indian. Long Varanasi's go-to for business lunches and arriving travellers wanting AC and a proper bar.
insider_tip: Sit outside on winter evenings; Mangri Ferra (the open-air juice bar in the same complex) handles afternoon coffee better than the indoor room.
signature_address: Hotel Surya Kaiser Palace, S-20/51 A-5, The Mall Road, Varuna Bridge, Cantonment, Varanasi 221002

name: Varuna
why_it_matters: Indian-specialty restaurant inside Taj Ganges (formerly The Gateway Hotel Ganges) — the city's only five-star kitchen running a dedicated Awadhi-Mughlai menu, set in 40 acres of Cantonment gardens.
insider_tip: The all-day room Chowk handles breakfast and casual meals; book Varuna only for the kebab tasting menu — the daytime crowd here is in-house.
signature_address: Taj Ganges, Nadesar Palace Grounds, Raja Bazaar Road, Cantonment, Varanasi 221002
